# FleetForge Audit — Invoices & Credit Notes Module

The invoices/credit-notes module is structurally sound at the perimeter (auth gates present, parameterized queries, CSRF intact) but carries **0 Critical, 9 High, 11 Medium, 12 Low, 7 Info** confirmed findings plus a Refuted/by-design appendix. Four clusters dominate: **AR-counter integrity** — every send/void/delete/payment-void path (I05–I08) does check-then-act on an unlocked, pre-transaction read then issues an unconditional `id`-keyed UPDATE, so concurrent or retried requests double-apply the canonical Path-B `outstanding_balance`/`total_revenue` counters; **payment & redaction security** — the documented "no amounts (enforced in API)" dispatcher redaction contract was never written for this module (I03), exposing every total/tax/balance/AR-bucket to a factory-default role across JSON, both admin pages, and the print PDF; **QBO sync resilience** — all four AR pushers drop HTTP status/fault codes via `method_exists()` on readonly properties (I04) and swallow transient 429/5xx so the worker's backoff arm is unreachable (I21), latent only because `sync_enabled='0'` pre-cutover; and **portal disclosure** — invoice detail and the "All" tab leak the customer's own draft/void invoices (I01, I02). Two customer-facing money flows are fully broken behind default-off flags: SES attachments are silently dropped so invoice/dunning PDFs are logged as attached but never delivered (I14), and portal "Pay Online" navigates to `undefined` on both success and failure (I10).

---

## Critical

None.

---

## High

### [High] Dispatcher redaction contract unimplemented module-wide — invoice/credit-note amounts served to `payments:NONE` roles
File: `api/v1/invoices/index.php:114-154`; `show.php:30-145`; `kpis.php:26-71`; `app/admin/invoices/index.php:29-60`; `app/admin/invoices/show.php:32`; `api/v1/credit_notes/index.php:104-108`, `show.php:183-199`, `kpis.php:57-63`
```php
// config/permissions.php:202
'invoices' => $V,  // status + dates only — no amounts (enforced in API)
'payments' => $NONE,
// auth.php:200 — can_view_financials() = can('payments','view') → FALSE for dispatcher
// api/v1/invoices/index.php — NO can_view_financials() anywhere; emits:
subtotal, discount_amount, subtotal_after_discount, tax_total,
total_amount, amount_paid, credits_applied, balance_due
```
Why: A factory-default dispatcher (invoices:view, payments:NONE) reads every invoice/credit-note total, tax, balance, amount paid, AR-aging buckets, and per-line rates via the JSON API, both admin pages, and the printed PDF (`@media print` deliberately keeps `.financial-summary-card`). The contract names `can_view_financials()` as the single money gate; a repo-wide grep finds zero redaction in `api/v1/invoices/`, `api/v1/credit_notes/`, or `app/admin/invoices/`. Sibling endpoints (customers/index.php:190-194, leases/index.php:144) already redact, proving this module is the gap.
Fix: Apply serve-time redaction keyed on `can_view_financials()`, mirroring customers/leases: null the money set in show.php, `redact_rows(...)` the list, zero `*_total` (keep `*_cnt`) in kpis. Same for credit_notes. Gate admin KPI tiles + money columns behind `if (can_view_financials())` (also closes the print path). Re-gate the "Email Invoice" button (currently `can('customers','create')`) on `can('invoices','edit') && can_view_financials()`. Keep `report_cache` role-blind.
Verification: Add a regression smoke asserting a dispatcher session receives nulls/no currency from every endpoint and that the admin pages render no amount nodes.

### [High] All four AR pushers use `method_exists()` on QuickBooksException readonly properties — HTTP status + fault code dropped on every push/void failure
File: `lib/QboPushers/InvoicePusher.php:325,333,818,826`; `CreditMemoPusher.php:243,416`; `CreditApplicationPusher.php:146,259`; `RefundReceiptPusher.php:174`
```php
// QuickBooksException.php:29,32 — PROPERTIES, no getters, no __call:
public readonly ?string $errorCode;
public readonly ?int $httpStatus;
// InvoicePusher.php:325 — method_exists() against a property is ALWAYS false:
$httpCode = method_exists($e, 'getHttpStatus') ? (int) $e->getHttpStatus() : 0;  // → 0
'error_code' => method_exists($e, 'getErrorCode') ? $e->getErrorCode() : null,    // → null
// CustomerPusher.php:267 already does it right:
$httpCode = $e->httpStatus ?? 0;
```
Why: `$httpCode` is always 0 and `error_code` always null on every push/void failure. `recordPushFailure()` only prepends `HTTP {code}:` when `httpCode>0`, so it never persists; the worker (qbo_sync_worker.php:328) falls back to `error_code='qbo_error'`. 401 auth-expired, 409 stale-object, 429 rate-limit, 400 validation, and 6240 duplicate all classify identically — blinding retry-classification, auth-refresh routing, drift alerting, and the operator Push-State UI on the highest-volume AR entities. This is the exact defect already fixed in CustomerPusher/VendorPusher; these 4 were missed. Latent only because `sync_enabled='0'`.
Fix: Replace every `method_exists()` ternary with direct reads — `$httpCode = $e->httpStatus ?? 0;` and `'error_code' => $e->errorCode ?? null,` at all 9 sites. Consider a shared `qbo_error_tuple(QuickBooksException $e): array` helper.
Verification: Smoke that throws a QuickBooksException with known httpStatus/errorCode through each pusher and asserts the recorded failure carries them; guard asserting no `method_exists($e,'getHttpStatus')` survives in `lib/QboPushers/`.

### [High] Invoice send/void check-then-act with no row lock + unconditional UPDATE → concurrent send/void double-applies AR counters, GL JEs, notifications
File: `lib/AI/Actions/FinancialActions.php:152-167,207-234` (send); `39-50,52-101` (void)
```php
// 152: read OUTSIDE txn, no FOR UPDATE
$invoice = db_row("SELECT id, status, ... balance_due, lease_id ... WHERE id=? AND deleted_at IS NULL", [$id]);
if ($invoice['status'] !== 'draft') throw ActionException('INVALID_TRANSITION', ...);  // 161, stale read
// 207: unconditional WHERE id=? — NO `AND status='draft'`, rowCount discarded
db_update('invoices', ['status'=>'sent', ...], 'id = ?', [$id]);
// 217-234: increments customers.outstanding_balance/total_revenue, leases.OB, equipment from STALE values
```
Why: Two concurrent sends (double-click, retried request, AI-confirm racing the manual button) both pass the guard and both run the body → OB and total_revenue increment twice; last-writer-wins on the row hides it. Symmetric double-decrement for void; the only FOR UPDATE locks the *lease* precharge row (182), which doesn't serialize ordinary sends. Optimistic locking is disabled app-wide so nothing else guards the window. The credit-note paths (apply.php, CreditApplicationReversal.php) correctly re-read FOR UPDATE; these don't. The CODEX 2026-05-26 audit flagged this as Critical on the inline send.php/void.php; the logic was moved into FinancialActions verbatim without the fix.
Fix: Make the transition atomic/self-guarding: `UPDATE invoices SET status='sent',... WHERE id=? AND status='draft' AND deleted_at IS NULL` (void: `status IN ('draft','sent')`), treat affected-rows=0 as INVALID_TRANSITION, run counter/JE/notification writes only when one row transitioned. Or re-read FOR UPDATE inside the txn and recompute counters from the locked row.
Verification: Concurrency smoke firing two simultaneous sends of the same draft; assert OB/total_revenue moved by exactly one invoice's worth and only one JE/notification posted.

### [High] bulk_void / bulk_delete share the same unlocked-read + unconditional id-keyed UPDATE → double-reverse AR counters; bulk_void also skips cache invalidation
File: `api/v1/invoices/bulk_void.php:87-91,107,134-194,246-250`; `bulk_delete.php:72,85,95-201,212-214`
```php
// bulk_void.php:87 read OUTSIDE txn; :107 PHP gate; :134 unconditional, id-only, no FOR UPDATE:
db_update('invoices', ['status'=>'void','balance_due'=>'0.00',...], 'id = ?', [$id]);
// :147-194 unconditional counter decrements
// :246 json_success(...) — NO invalidate_dashboard_cache() (bulk_delete.php:212 has it)
```
Why: Two requests that both observe status='sent' (bulk_void overlapping void.php, or the same id in two parallel bulk POSTs) both pass the gate and both subtract `balance_due`/`total_amount` from customers OB/total_revenue → double-decremented. `db_transaction()` is a bare begin/commit with no locking; optimistic locking disabled. Bulk amplifies the count of narrow windows. Separately, bulk_void mutates AR/revenue counters that feed dashboard widgets but never invalidates `report_cache`, leaving AR/revenue tiles stale until TTL. (Contested — 1 of 2 verifiers rated this medium, noting the single-void path FinancialActions::voidInvoice shares the identical race and missing-cache shape, so this is a codebase-wide pattern rather than a bulk-specific defect, and each collision corrupts only one invoice's worth.)
Fix: Conditional `UPDATE ... WHERE id=? AND status IN ('draft','sent')` (bulk_delete: `WHERE id=? AND deleted_at IS NULL`); apply decrements only when affected-rows=1. Add `if ($actioned > 0) invalidate_dashboard_cache();` before json_success in bulk_void.php (and in FinancialActions::voidInvoice).
Verification: Concurrency smoke on same-id parallel bulk POSTs asserting single counter delta; assert dashboard cache invalidated after a bulk void.

### [High] Credit-note Apply/Void/Update/Create UI handlers run success logic on FAILED saves (FF_Api.post resolves on 4xx/422)
File: `app/admin/credit_notes/show.php:464-480` (apply), `493-512` (editMeta), `526-542` (void); `create.php:285-296`
```js
// app.js:192 — resolves on ANY status:
async post(url, data={}) { const res = await fetch(...); return res.json(); }
// editMeta.save() — lies on a 409/422 IMMUTABLE_RECORD/STALE_DATA:
.then(() => { this.success = 'Changes saved.'; })
// applyForm.submit() — data.data undefined on 422 → TypeError → generic .catch hides server reason:
.then(data => { this.success = 'Applied '+this.amount+' to invoice '+data.data.invoice_number...; })
// voidModal.submit() — reloads on a failed void:
.then(() => { location.reload(); })
// create.php — overlay+redirect ungated → redirects to show?id=undefined on VALIDATION_ERROR
```
Why: Operators see fake success / reloads on failed financial-document actions (over-amount credit apply, void, metadata edit, goodwill credit) and never see the actionable server reason. The sibling `unapply()` (show.php:374-378) correctly gates `if(r.success)`, proving these are oversights. Backend correctly rejects (no AR corruption), but editMeta's "Changes saved." actively lies over money operations.
Fix: Gate every handler on the response, mirroring unapply(): `.then(r => { if (!r.success) { this.error = r.error?.message || '...'; this.submitting=false; return; } /* success */ })`. For create.php, branch on `data.success` before setting `showSuccessOverlay`/`_newId`/redirect. Also delete the dead identical-branch ternary at show.php:465 (I49).
Verification: Drive each handler against a forced 422/409 in preview; assert no success banner/reload/redirect and that the server message surfaces.

### [High] Portal "Pay Online" reads url/error off the wrong envelope level — navigates to `undefined` on success AND failure
File: `app/portal/invoices/view.php:138-150`
```js
const r = await FF_Api.post('.../initiate_qbo_payment', { invoice_id: invoiceId });
if (r.success) { window.location.href = r.url; }   // r.success is OUTER flag, always true; r.url undefined
else { this.error = r.error || ...; this.loading = false; }   // unreachable
```
Why: `initiate_qbo_payment.php:62` always returns `json_success($result)`, which bootstrap wraps as `{success:true, data:{success,status,url,error}}`. The outer `success` is always true, so the code always takes the success branch and navigates to literal `undefined` — on real success (url is at `r.data.url`) and on every preflight failure (feature_disabled, not_connected, currency mismatch, qbo_error). The descriptive error is never shown. Latent only because `quickbooks.payments_enabled` defaults `'0'` (button + script hidden); breaks the entire customer payment flow the moment it's enabled at cutover.
Fix: `const env = await FF_Api.post(...); const r = env.data || {}; if (env.success && r.success && r.url) { window.location.href = r.url; } else { this.error = r.error || ('Unable to start payment: '+(r.status||'unknown error')); this.loading=false; }`
Verification: Enable the flag in preview; assert a real success redirects to the QBO URL and a preflight failure surfaces the error instead of navigating.

### [High] Invoices kpis.php AR-aging totals are not CAD-converted — USD invoices summed 1:1, understating AR
File: `api/v1/invoices/kpis.php:27,34,44,54`; parallel aggregates `app/admin/invoices/index.php:30-56`
```sql
-- raw, no currency handling:
COALESCE(SUM(balance_due), 0) AS total
-- customers/kpis.php:73 does it right:
SUM(CASE WHEN currency='USD' THEN balance_due*COALESCE(exchange_rate_to_cad,1) ELSE balance_due END)
```
Why: `invoices` stores `currency enum('CAD','USD')` and `exchange_rate_to_cad`. The operator-locked 2026-06-13 CAD-canonical policy is applied everywhere else (customers/kpis.php, dashboard/kpis.php, dashboard/charts.php); this endpoint is the outlier. A USD 10,000 balance shows as 10,000 in a CAD-canonical tile, so invoice tiles disagree with the customer/dashboard tiles. (Contested — both verifiers adjusted high→medium: display-only KPI tiles, no stored balance is mutated, impact gated on USD currency mix.)
Fix: Replace each `SUM(balance_due)` with the CASE-conversion + `bcround`, mirroring customers/kpis.php:73-85. Apply identically to `app/admin/invoices/index.php:30-56`.
Verification: Seed a USD invoice and assert the tile total equals the CAD-converted figure and matches the customers tile.

### [High] Portal invoice detail (view.php) renders the customer's own DRAFT and VOID invoices — no status gate
File: `app/portal/invoices/view.php:23-34`
```php
$inv = db_row("SELECT i.*, l.contract_number FROM invoices i ... WHERE i.id = ? AND i.customer_id = ? AND i.deleted_at IS NULL", [$invoiceId, $cid]);
// no `AND i.status NOT IN ('draft','void')` — void badge arm at ~:84 confirms voids render
```
Why: A portal user can open `/portal/invoices/view?id=<n>` for any of their own customer's invoices including draft (internal, never sent) and void (cancelled), seeing full line items, totals, tax, FX, payment history. IDs are sequential/guessable. Scoped to the customer's own tenant (not cross-tenant IDOR), but a documented disclosure-contract violation — exactly the leak `app/portal/leases/view.php:41-48` just fixed. (Contested — 1 of 2 verifiers rated this medium given own-customer-only scope and no AR-integrity impact.)
Fix: Add the disclosure predicate mirroring I02's settled set — `AND i.status NOT IN ('void') AND (i.status != 'draft' OR i.generation_source='advance')` (the list deliberately discloses advance drafts). Redirect to the list on miss.
Verification: As a portal user, request a draft and a void invoice id; assert redirect to list.

### [High] Portal "All" tab list query has no status filter — leaks DRAFT and VOID; rows and count disagree
File: `app/portal/invoices/index.php:22-44` (rows), `56-61` (count)
```php
$where = ['i.customer_id = ?', 'i.deleted_at IS NULL'];
if ($tab === 'outstanding') { $where[] = "i.status IN ('sent','partially_paid','overdue')"; }
elseif ($tab === 'paid')    { $where[] = "i.status = 'paid'"; }
// tab='all': NO status predicate → returns draft, void, written_off
// count (:60) DOES exclude: "AND (status != 'draft' OR generation_source = 'advance')"
```
Why: The All tab returns the customer's draft/void/written_off invoices, and the tab badge count (which hides non-advance drafts) disagrees with the visible row count. (Contested — 1 of 2 verifiers rated this medium: own-customer scope, not cross-tenant; disclosure of internal lifecycle states + count/list mismatch.)
Fix: Apply an identical predicate to both the row WHERE and the count: always `i.status NOT IN ('void','written_off')` plus `(i.status != 'draft' OR i.generation_source='advance')`.
Verification: As a portal user with a non-advance draft, assert the All tab omits it and the badge count equals the visible rows.

---

## Medium

### [Medium] Super-admin delete of a sent/paid invoice reverses counters but posts NO reversing GL JE and orphans payment_allocations + applied credit notes
File: `api/v1/invoices/delete.php:42,47-157`; `bulk_delete.php:92-201`
```php
if ($invoice['status'] !== 'draft' && !is_super_admin())  // :42 super_admin bypass
// db_transaction: decrements counters but NEVER calls AutoEntryBridge::onInvoiceVoided,
// never reverses payment_allocations / leases.total_paid, never restores credit_note_applications
```
Why: A super-admin hard-delete of a non-draft invoice leaves the original revenue JE posted (GL overstates vs zeroed counters), orphans `payment_allocations` pointing at a soft-deleted invoice with `leases.total_paid` not walked back, and leaves applied credit consumed (`credit_notes.amount_remaining`/status not restored) — silent customer credit loss. Credits *can* be applied to exactly the statuses (sent/partially_paid/overdue) a super-admin can delete (apply.php:98-101). `bulk_void.php:99-114` explicitly guards the paid case; delete/bulk_delete don't. A later payment void compounds drift via the Path-B deleted-invoice terminal-skip.
Fix: Either drop the `is_super_admin()` bypass at line 42 (route sent/paid through void → credit note), or refuse with IMMUTABLE_RECORD when `amount_paid>0 OR credits_applied>0` even for super_admin (mirroring bulk_void's gate). Apply identically to bulk_delete.php.
Verification: Smoke deleting a sent invoice and asserting the revenue JE is reversed (or the delete refused).

### [Medium] voidPayment shares the lock-free check-then-act window — concurrent payment voids double-reverse amount_paid / customers.outstanding_balance / leases.total_paid
File: `lib/AI/Actions/FinancialActions.php:303-321,326,376,389`
```php
// 303-321: read payment + allocations OUTSIDE txn, no FOR UPDATE
db_update('payments', ['deleted_at'=>$now], 'id = ?', [$id]);  // 326: unconditional, no `AND deleted_at IS NULL`
// 389: customers.outstanding_balance += allocated — NO floor (total_paid at 386 uses GREATEST(0,...))
```
Why: Two concurrent/retried voids of the same payment both read it live and both run the full reversal → OB double-incremented (no floor) and total_paid double-decremented. Permanent AR drift on a deliberate but un-serialized destructive action. Lower likelihood than invoice send (payments voided less often), same corruption class.
Fix: Re-read FOR UPDATE inside the txn (`WHERE id=? AND deleted_at IS NULL`) and abort if gone, or make the soft-delete conditional and run reversals only when one row was affected. Re-read allocations under the lock.
Verification: Concurrency smoke on same-payment parallel voids asserting single OB/total_paid delta.

### [Medium] Voiding a credit note silently DESTROYS its existing internal_notes — column never SELECTed before the append-write
File: `api/v1/credit_notes/void.php:69,92`
```php
// :69 FOR UPDATE SELECT fetches only id, credit_note_number, status, amount_remaining
'internal_notes' => trim(($cn['internal_notes'] ?? '') . "\n---\nVoid reason: {$reason}")  // :92 → ?? '' collapses
```
Why: `$cn['internal_notes']` is an undefined key → `?? ''` empties it → the UPDATE overwrites internal_notes with only the void-reason line, discarding staff-entered approval/goodwill/dispute notes (populated at create.php:181). The audit_log old_values (:104) records only status + amount_remaining, so there is no recovery copy.
Fix: Add `internal_notes` to the FOR UPDATE SELECT at line 69.
Verification: Void a credit note that has internal_notes set; confirm notes are preserved + appended.

### [Medium] Email attachments are silently dropped — Mailer uses SES `sendEmail` (not `sendRawEmail`), so invoice/dunning PDFs are logged "attached" but never delivered
File: `lib/Notifications/Mailer.php:51-58,113-171`
```php
public static function send(string $toEmail, string $toName, string $subject, string $htmlBody, string $textBody = '', array $replyTo = [])  // no $attachments
// sendViaSes builds Message.Body.Html/Text + Subject only; self::ses()->sendEmail($params)
// grep sendRawEmail → 0 hits
```
Why: `EmailService::send()` resolves and persists attachment rows to `email_attachments` (the history "attached" record) but calls `Mailer::send()` with no attachments arg. The invoice Compose modal (api/v1/email/send.php:104-120, invoice_id→pdf_path) and AR dunning (dunning_letter.php:89-94) both feed PDFs into this path. Customers receive invoice/dunning emails with no PDF while the email-history tab claims it was attached — a billing/collections failure and audit-trail lie. PDFs persist server-side (recoverable), so not critical.
Fix: Add `array $attachments = []` to `Mailer::send()` and switch sendViaSes() to SES `sendRawEmail` with a MIME multipart/mixed message when attachments are present; thread EmailService's attachments through. Until then, surface an explicit "attachments not supported" error rather than logging them as sent.
Verification: Send an invoice via Compose and assert the SES raw message contains the PDF part.

### [Medium] email_disabled / SES bounce-suppression gate keyed only on customers.email — invoices send to invoice_email/billing_email, so a bouncing alternate address is never blocked
File: `lib/Notifications/Mailer.php:285-299`; `api/v1/webhooks/ses_notifications.php:214`
```php
SELECT email_disabled FROM customers WHERE LOWER(email)=? ...   // billing_email/invoice_email never consulted
```
Why: Invoice sends use `customer_email_snapshot`/`sent_to_email` (FinancialActions::sendInvoice:166-167), commonly the billing/AP address (`invoice_email` ≠ `customers.email`). A hard bounce on `invoice_email='ap@bigco.com'` matches no row → never disabled, and every future send passes `isEmailDisabled()=false`. Breaks the "disabled address must be re-enabled by a manager" guarantee for the most common invoicing case — SES reputation/account-suspension exposure.
Fix: Match against all address columns (`WHERE LOWER(email)=? OR LOWER(billing_email)=? OR LOWER(invoice_email)=?`) and have the SES webhook disable the matching column. Ideally introduce an address-keyed suppression table (also closes I16).
Verification: Disable an invoice_email-only address, attempt a send, assert it's blocked.

### [Medium] email/send.php audit_log insert uses a non-existent `description` column — every "Sent email" audit row is silently dropped
File: `api/v1/email/send.php:156-168`
```php
db_insert('audit_log', [ ... 'description' => 'Sent email to ' . $toEmail . ' — ' . $subject, ... ]);
// audit_log has `notes`, not `description` → PDOException, swallowed by try/catch → only error_log()
```
Why: The generated INSERT references a column that doesn't exist; the catch only `error_log()`s while the endpoint returns 201. Customer-facing emails (including invoice Compose sends) get no audit_log entry despite the code intending one — a compliance/traceability gap, invisible. Sibling email endpoints (bulk.php:123, templates/create.php:105, etc.) share the mismatch.
Fix: Rename the key to `notes` (add entity_label/user_name to match the table). Audit sibling email-module inserts for the same mismatch.
Verification: Send an email and confirm an audit_log row is written.

### [Medium] Transient QBO failures (429/5xx) on invoice + credit-note pushes are caught-and-returned, so the worker's backoff/retry arm is unreachable
File: `lib/QboPushers/InvoicePusher.php:324` (also pushVoidImpl:817; CreditMemoPusher / CreditApplicationPusher same shape)
```php
catch (QuickBooksException $e) { ...recordFailure; return ['outcome'=>'failed']; }
// QuickBooksTransientException extends QuickBooksException → caught here; worker's
// catch (QuickBooksTransientException) backoff arm (qbo_sync_worker.php:361) never fires
```
Why: A QBO rate-limit burst or transient 5xx during a sent-invoice/credit-memo push is marked permanently `failed` instead of backing off, leaving the FF invoice un-synced and requiring manual re-enqueue exactly when queue-level backoff is most valuable. Compounds with I04 (dropped error_code) so the operator can't tell it was transient.
Fix: Re-throw the transient subclass before the generic handler: `catch (QuickBooksTransientException $e) { throw $e; } catch (QuickBooksException $e) { ...record+return... }`. Apply to invoice + credit-note pushers.
Verification: Smoke throwing QuickBooksTransientException through a pusher and asserting the worker requeues with backoff rather than marking failed.

### [Medium] QBO invoice list.php status whitelist omits 3 real push_status enum values → filtering by them silently returns ALL rows
File: `api/v1/quickbooks/invoices/list.php:34-45`
```php
$validStatuses = ['pending','pushed','failed','skipped_voided','skipped_by_mode','skipped_soft_deleted','failed_preflight'];
// acc_qbo_invoice_map.push_status enum also has: voided, failed_preflight_field_too_long, failed_preflight_currency_mismatch
// array_intersect → [] → `if (!empty($statusFilter))` skipped → query returns every row
```
Why: The operator triaging QBO push failures cannot isolate typed-preflight or voided rows; requesting them returns the unfiltered list with no error. `retry.php:49` treats the two `failed_preflight_*` values as retryable, so the operator legitimately needs to filter to them (invoices.php:100 offers them as checkboxes) but cannot.
Fix: Add the missing enum values to `$validStatuses` (source from a shared constant). When a status param was passed but the intersection is empty, return an explicit empty result rather than show-all.
Verification: Filter by `failed_preflight_field_too_long` and assert only those rows return.

### [Medium] AR-aging tile totals (kpis.php) include partially_paid but the drill-down list filter excludes it — tile total never reconciles with the list
File: `api/v1/invoices/kpis.php:29,36,46,56` vs `api/v1/invoices/index.php:78-95`
```php
// kpis current: status IN ('sent','partially_paid');  ar30/60/90: IN ('sent','partially_paid','overdue')
// index drill-down current: status='sent';  ar30/60/90: IN ('sent','overdue')  — partially_paid absent
```
Why: Clicking an AR tile loads a list whose `SUM(balance_due)` can't equal the tile figure for any customer with partially-paid invoices — counts and totals visibly mismatch, undermining trust in AR numbers.
Fix: Use one status set in both places (include `partially_paid` in the index.php aging filter to match kpis.php and the true outstanding population); update the index.php header comment.
Verification: With a partially-paid overdue invoice, assert tile total equals the drilled list total.

### [Medium] Portal payment-initiation endpoint emits an HTML redirect instead of JSON 401/403 when the portal account is revoked mid-session
File: `api/v1/portal/invoices/initiate_qbo_payment.php:29` → `app/portal/includes/auth.php:69-88`
```php
// require_portal_auth() on revoked/unauthenticated session:
header('Location: ' . base_url('portal/auth/login')); exit;   // 302 HTML, not JSON envelope
```
Why: This JSON API endpoint guards with `require_portal_auth()`, which page-redirects with no `FF_API_CONTEXT` check. A fetch client branching on `r.success` gets a 302→login HTML body that parses as an opaque failure. Access is correctly blocked (PaymentInitiator never runs, independently re-verifies ownership) — not an authz hole, only a JSON-contract/UX defect on suspension/timeout.
Fix: Use the portal API bootstrap variant that returns `json_error('NOT_AUTHENTICATED',...,401)` when `portal_user()` is null or the session is revoked, instead of the page-redirecting helper. *(Note: I20's title labels this "Low" but the dimension is error-handling; final severity is low per verdict — listed here adjacent to the payment endpoint for context. See Low section.)*

### [Low] Credit-apply clamps OB with GREATEST(0,...) but unapply restores unclamped — apply/unapply roundtrip amplifies pre-existing AR drift
File: `api/v1/credit_notes/apply.php:255-258`; `lib/CreditApplicationReversal.php:149-152`
```php
UPDATE customers SET outstanding_balance = GREATEST(0, outstanding_balance - ?)   // apply: floored
UPDATE customers SET outstanding_balance = outstanding_balance + ?                 // unapply: uncapped
```
Why: In a consistent Path-B state the clamp never fires. But if OB was already drifted below `amount_applied`, the clamp loses the residual and the later unapply adds the full amount back (OB 30 −40→0, +40→40, drift +10) — converting recoverable drift into a larger self-reinforcing one, with no audit signal. (Contested confidence — requires pre-existing drift.)
Fix: Make the two sides symmetric (drop the clamp, or cap the unapply restore). At minimum emit an audit/error_log warning when the clamp fires.

## Refuted / already-fixed / by-design

- **I25 — kpis.php buckets lack `balance_due > 0`** (wont-fix-by-design): The invoice state machine couples `balance_due=0` with `status='paid'` at every canonical mutation site (PaymentWebhookHandler.php:305, apply.php:237, BankService.php:787; update.php locks balances immutable for non-draft per D14). 'paid' is excluded from all four buckets, so no zero-balance sent/partially_paid row can reach them — count and total stay consistent. Adding the predicate would guard a condition the state machine already prevents.
- **I47 — 'overdue' not in VOIDABLE** (wont-fix-by-design): `VOIDABLE = ['draft','sent']` matches the documented §6 state machine (draft→void, sent→void; paid/overdue route through a credit note). No corruption; the void math would handle overdue correctly, but the exclusion is deliberate product policy, not a bug.
- **I48 — draft→void decrements leases.total_invoiced unconditionally** (wont-fix-by-design): `leases.total_invoiced` is booked at *draft-create* (InvoiceGenerator.php:1571-1590, "Path B: total_invoiced INCLUDES drafts — lease-internal total"), unlike customer/equipment `total_revenue` which is booked at send. The unconditional void-time decrement is the correct symmetric reversal and cannot push the counter negative; delete.php:99 and bulk_void.php:149 apply the same convention. This is the intended Path-B asymmetry.

**Path B by-design boundary (applies throughout):** `customers.outstanding_balance` reflects SENT invoices only — incremented on draft→sent, never decremented by payments (canonical AR is the customer counter; `leases.outstanding_balance` is non-canonical and intentionally not decremented on apply). Findings I05–I08/I13 are real because they cause the Path-B counters to be applied *more than once* or asymmetrically — distinct from the intended increment-on-send semantics, which are not bugs.

**Prior-CODEX-now-context:** The 2026-05-26 CODEX invoices-billing audit flagged the send/void/delete stale-snapshot counter race as Critical on the inline endpoints; the logic was moved verbatim into `FinancialActions` without the conditional-UPDATE/FOR-UPDATE fix, so I05/I06 are unfixed carry-forwards (not moot). CODEX's credit_notes/update.php null-old_values item (I12) and lease-OB-on-apply concern are separate and also unfixed. The Customer/Vendor pusher `method_exists()` fix (I04 reference) WAS applied to CustomerPusher/VendorPusher; the four AR pushers were missed.

## Completeness critic — gaps to audit next

I have enough to compile the prioritized gap list. The attachment path attaches a pre-existing `pdf_path` but nothing in the audit covers WHERE/HOW that invoice PDF is generated (it's referenced as "out of scope"), and there's no email header-injection probe of the Compose subject/body→Mailer path. Also `api/v1/email/bulk.php` exists with rate-limiting and is an unprobed invoice-email dispatch surface.

Prioritized gaps (file + what to check), excluding already-found issues:

**P1 — payment-recording path, entirely uncovered**
- `api/v1/payments/create.php` — THE canonical payment-recording endpoint. It is what the invoice show page's "Record Payment" button links to (show.php:1360/1569/2998/3011) and it mutates every AR counter the rest of the cluster is built around: `invoices.amount_paid`/`balance_due`, invoice status transition (sent→partially_paid→paid), `leases.total_paid`, `customers.outstanding_balance`, all in one txn with FOR UPDATE (D20). Coverage probed `payments/delete.php`, `allocate.php`, `kpis.php`, `index.php` but NEVER `create.php`. Check: D18 currency-match, overpayment handling (S-FIX-2 Bug #2 — overpayments now accepted, so verify balance_due floor / negative-balance behavior), Path B status guard parity with void/apply, idempotency on payment_number, and that the invoice→Path-B OB increment here is consistent with sendInvoice (double-count risk: does recording a payment on a still-draft invoice or a never-sent invoice mis-move OB?).
- `app/admin/payments/create.php` (the page behind `/payments/create?invoice_id=`) — the invoice-scoped Record Payment UI handler; pre-fill from invoice_id, success gating, money render. Not in inventory or coverage at all.

**P2 — statement generation, entirely uncovered**
- `api/v1/accounting/ar/statement.php` — generates a customer statement as a **PDF binary stream** (`Content-Type: application/pdf`) aggregating all invoices, payments, credit notes, write-offs, opening/closing balance + aged summary for a date range. This is a money-bearing serve surface gated on `require_permission('journal_entries','view')` — NOT `can_view_financials()`/payments:view. Check: (a) permission mismatch — a dispatcher-class or journal-only role getting full dollar AR exposure the API contract says to strip; (b) date_from/date_to input validation (clean_date) feeding the SQL; (c) customer_id scoping / IDOR; (d) PDF-generation library injection (un-escaped customer name / invoice fields into the PDF renderer).
- `app/admin/accounting/statements/index.php` — statement UI handler (customer/date picker, dispatch). Uncovered.

**P3 — invoice PDF generation path is a documented blind spot**
- The audit treats invoice-PDF creation as "out of scope": `email/send.php:112` skips the attachment `if empty($inv['pdf_path'])`, and the only `pdf_path` *writers* found are `lib/Accounting/DunningLetterGenerator.php` (dunning, not invoices). There is no entry covering what populates `invoices.pdf_path`, where the invoice PDF is rendered, or the renderer's escaping of invoice/customer fields. Check: locate the invoice-PDF generator (or confirm pdf_path is never populated → "Record Payment"/email attach silently degrades), and audit the renderer for HTML/template injection from invoice notes/customer name and for path traversal when `pdf_path` is later read by `Mailer`/`api/v1/storage/serve.php`.

**P4 — email dispatch surfaces (header injection + rate-limit) under-probed**
- `api/v1/email/bulk.php` — uncovered invoice/customer bulk-email endpoint and the ONLY place rate-limiting (`rate_limit`) appears in this cluster. Check: per-recipient throttle, recipient-list validation, attachment resolution reuse, and whether bulk invoice sends bypass the single-send `email_disabled` gate.
- `lib/Email/EmailService::send` + `lib/Notifications/Mailer::sendViaSes` — email **header-injection** dimension is unprobed. Coverage confirms recipient `FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL` and display-name quoting, but does NOT verify the Compose **subject** line (and any operator-supplied reply-to / from-name) is stripped of CR/LF before reaching SES `sendEmail`. Check: subject/replyTo CRLF sanitization in the Compose→EmailService→Mailer chain (subject originates from `app/admin/invoices/show.php` openEmailCompose).

**P5 — QBO undeposited_funds payment mapping (explicitly flagged in memory, never probed)**
- `lib/QboPushers/PaymentPusher.php` + `PaymentEnqueuer.php` + `PaymentWebhookHandler.php` — the dress-rehearsal memo records "payments need an FF undeposited_funds account mapped" as a real-cutover finding, and the portal `initiate_qbo_payment` path lands a payment back into FF via webhook. None of these three pushers/handler are in the inventory or coverage. Check: the undeposited_funds / deposit-account mapping gate in PaymentPusher, the `method_exists` QuickBooksException trap (same defect class as InvoicePusher 325/333/818/826 — verify PaymentPusher/PaymentWebhookHandler don't repeat it), and webhook-handler idempotency/ownership when matching an inbound QBO payment to an FF invoice.

**P6 — minor / serve-time**
- `api/v1/quickbooks/invoices/list.php` & `retry.php` financial exposure — covered for auth/pagination but not checked against the `can_view_financials` redaction contract that the rest of the invoice read-surface was flagged for; the KPI rollup emits dollar totals under `quickbooks:view`, a different predicate than payments:view. Worth a redaction-consistency note.
